[올림 함수: ceil(), ceiling()](#244eda9b0fe180b8a631dc2274d9ac68) > - [내림 함수: floor()](#244eda9b0fe1800a81fee35db885e733) > - [반올림 함수: round(값, 소수점)](#244eda9b0fe180d6b6eefa3bdd7e5c16) ### 절댓값 반환: ABS() ( absolute ) ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT ABS(-15) FROM dual # 결과: 15 ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80d4-838e-ef4b5007b35e/b51e5d21ad01dd6c.webp) ### 음수, 양수, 0 판단: SIGN() > ✏️ > > - 양수: 1 > > - 0: 0 > > - 음수: -1 ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT SIGN(-15) # 결과: -1 SIGN(0) # 결과: 0 SIGN(51351) # 결과: 1 FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80d4-838e-ef4b5007b35e/0c4943f4b9d07eb5.webp) ### 나머지 연산: mod(), % ```sql # Oracle SELECT mod(7, 3) # 결과: 1 FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80d4-838e-ef4b5007b35e/f10596f6cc814620.webp) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT 7%4 # 결과: 3 FROM dual ``` ### 올림 함수: ceil(), ceiling() ```sql # Oracle SELECT ceil(38.123), # 결과: 39 FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80d4-838e-ef4b5007b35e/b6df7b8fa4211865.webp) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT ceiling(38.123), # 결과: 39 FROM dual ``` ### 내림 함수: floor() ```sql # Oracle, SQL Server SELECT floor(38.123), # 결과: 38 FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/244eda9b-0fe1-80d4-838e-ef4b5007b35e/f3f75c05dc39cea9.webp) ### 반올림 함수: round(값, 소수점) ```sql # Oracle SELECT # Case 1) 2번째 인자: 소수점 round(38.125, 2), # 결과: 38.13 # Case 2) 2번째 인자 제거 round(38.535), # 결과: 39 # Case 3) 2번쨰 인자: 음수 round(38.535, -1) # 결과: 40 # '-1' 은 일의 자리를 뜻함 FROM dual ``` ```sql # SQL Server SELECT # Case 1) 2번째 인자: 소수점 round(38.125, 2), # 결과: 38.13 # Case 2) 2번째 인자 제거 불가 round(38.535, 0), # 결과: 39 # Case 3) 2번쨰 인자: 음수 round(38.535, -1) # 결과: 40 # '-1' 은 일의 자리를 뜻함 FROM dual ```
